about: Zadok anoints Solomon’s son, who rides the royal mule; Solomon dies and is carried to David’s tomb with great mourning. Israel asks him to lighten the work; the old counsellors say to yield, the young say to threaten, and he answers harshly. Israel throws off the house of David, casts lots at Samaria, and makes Jeroboam son of Nebat king, leaving Judah and Benjamin to Solomon’s son. The text sets this against the promise to David, fulfilled in Christ and, on earth, in Menelik of Ethiopia, and closes with a genealogy of Mary and Joseph.

sentences.l: And-then took-him Zadok priest and-made-king-him and-anointed-him and-did for-him what-by-his-law and-set wood upon tent and-found-him in-name-of his-father Solomon, and-they-mounted-him upon mule-of king and-they-said-to-him: Bah, living father-of king;
sentences.i: Then Zadok the priest took him, made him king, and anointed him, and did for him what the law required. He set wood on the tent, and found him in the name of his father Solomon; and they mounted him on the king’s mule and said to him, “Bah! May the father of the king live (?)!”
sentences.n: The verbs are mostly ወ- + 3ms perfect with an object suffix: ነሥኦ ‘took him’, ወአንገሦ ‘and made him king’ (causative of ነግሠ), ወቀብኦ ‘and anointed him’; ዘበሕጉ is ዘ- ‘that which’ + በ- ‘by’ + ሕግ ‘law’ + -ሁ, ‘what is by his law’. Zadok anoints the king as in 1 Kings 1:39; the mule (በቅል, here the construct before ንጉሥ) is the royal mule of 1 Kings 1:33, on which David had Solomon ride and on which Solomon’s son now rides. The son is not named here; the heading names him ሮብዓም (Rehoboam), but the story calls Solomon’s son ዮርብዓም or ኢዮርብዓም (Jeroboam), as in ch. 69, and the northern king of Ephraim bears the same name (see the notes below). አንበረ ዕፀ ዲበ ደብተራ ‘he set wood on the tent’ is obscure: ዕፀ may be ‘wood’ or a ritual object, ደብተራ ‘tent, tabernacle’ (?). ወረከቦ በስመ አቡሁ ሰሎሞን ‘and found him in the name of his father’ I take as ‘acknowledged him as his father’s successor’ (?). ባሕ is an exclamation or acclamation I cannot identify (?); ሕያው አበ ነጋሢ is read as a wish ‘may the king’s father live’ (?), with ነጋሢ ‘king’ (an agent noun of ነግሠ ‘reign’, ‘one who reigns’).

sentences.n: ወወሰክዎ ‘and they brought him’ (ወ- + ወሰከ, which the published parts read ‘add’; here ‘bring to, join to’ (?)) + -ዎ ‘him’; ኀበ መቃብረ ‘to the tomb of’, a construct before አቡሁ. ወላሐውዎ ለሰሎሞን ‘they lamented Solomon’ with ላሐ ‘lament’ as a cognate accusative, ዐቢየ ‘great’. እስመ አልቦ ዘተረክበ ዘከማሁ ‘for there is none who was found like him’; በውእቱ መዋዕል ‘in that day(s)’ with the plural noun. Compare 1 Kings 3:12 and 4:29–34.

sentences.i: After seven days had passed, they made Jeroboam leave off (?) the mourning for his father;
sentences.n: ወእምድኅረ ‘and after’; ኀለፈ ‘pass’ with ሰቡዐ መዋዕለ ‘seven days’, accusative of time; ሰቡዐ may be ሰቡዕ ‘week’, ‘a week of days’ (?), the sense the same. አንገፍዎ: the -ዎ ‘him’ is an object, with ላሐ አቡሁ ‘the lament of his father’ as a second object and ለዮርብዓም restating the first (as in ወአንገሥዎ ለኢዮርብዓም below): ‘they made him, Jeroboam, cease the mourning for his father’; the verb itself I cannot identify and take from the context (?). A reading ‘they ended the lament for his father (and went) to Jeroboam’ would leave the -ዎ unexplained (?). Seven days of mourning is the usual period (1 Samuel 31:13).

sentences.l: And-assembled people-of Israel to Jeroboam and-they-said-to-him: Lighten for-us work, for your-father made-heavy for-us by-cutting-of wood and-by-heaping(?)-of stone and-by-setting-up-of cart for-conveying wood cedar.
sentences.i: The people of Israel gathered to Jeroboam and said to him, “Lighten our work for us, for your father made it heavy on us with the cutting of wood, the heaping (?) of stone, the setting up of carts for conveying cedar wood.”
sentences.n: ወተጋብኡ ‘they assembled’ (tä-stem, from the root g-b-ʾ, ገብአ). The request follows 1 Kings 12:4, “lighten the hard service of your father.” አቅልል is the imperative of አቅለለ ‘make light’; the verbal nouns with በ- (‘by cutting’, ‘by heaping’) are constructs: ሐጢበ ዕፅ ‘cutting of wood’, ውቅረተ እብን ‘heaping of stone’ (?): ውቅረት may rather come from ወቀረ ‘pierce, dig out’, i.e. quarrying, so ‘heaping’ is a guess from the context. በአቅሞ ሰረገላ ‘by setting up a cart’ (አቅሞ is the infinitive of አቆመ). ለአርውጾ ዕፅ ቄድሮስ ‘for conveying cedar wood’ is uncertain; አርውጸ ‘make run, convey’ is a guess from the root (?). ቄድሮስ ‘cedar’ recalls the Lebanon cedars of Solomon’s building (1 Kings 5:6). ዮርብዓም here is Solomon’s son (Bezold’s Jeroboam, the Rehoboam of 1 Kings 12), as in ch. 69.

sentences.n: ወአቡከኒ ‘and your father also’ (-ኒ); ወሀበከ ኪያነ ‘he gave you us’, with ኪያነ the accusative pronoun. ደቂቀ ምሁራነ ፀብእ እስራኤል: ደቂቀ is the construct ‘sons of’, and I take እስራኤል as its genitive with ምሁራነ ፀብእ ‘skilled ones of war’ in apposition between them (?); ምሁራን is the plural of ምሁር ‘taught, skilled’ (ምሀረ ‘teach’), followed by ፀብእ ‘war’. ከመ ንልሀቅ ‘so that we grow great’ and ከመ ትጽናዕ ‘so that it be strong’ are subjunctives (ትጽናዕ, 3fs with subject መንግሥትከ, has a vowel pattern unlike ይጸንዕ below (?)); በጥበብ ‘in wisdom’ I take to mean Solomon’s wisdom in giving the king these men (?). እምድኅሬሁ ‘after him’ (እም + ድኅረ + -ሁ).

sentences.i: As for you, our lord, do not show those people a weak (?) face, lest they take you to be feeble and unable to make war on them and on your enemy; for if they see a face of weariness in us, in word and in deed, we shall be despised by them, and they will give us no gift and no tribute (?), no service (?) and no morning offering (?), and your kingdom will perish;
sentences.n: ወአንተሰ ‘as for you’; ኢታርእዮሙ ‘do not show them’ (prohibitive with the causative አርአየ); ዘኢትክል ‘and (one) who is not able’ (ዘ- + ኢ- + 2ms imperfect of ይክል); ኢይሁቡነ ‘and let them not give us’ (ኢ- + 3mp jussive of ወሀበ + -ነ); ገጸ ሕመቅ ‘a face of weakness’, ሕመቅ unclear (?), read from the parallel ገጸ ድካም ‘a face of weariness’. ከመ ኢያምስሉከ ‘lest they liken you’ (አምሰለ ‘be like, think’), ድኩመ ‘weak’ (ድኩም). ወእመሰ ‘and if indeed’; ንከውን ሕቁራነ ‘we shall be despised’, ሕቁራን plural of ሕቁር. The tributes: አምኃ ‘gift’, ወጋዳ ‘and tribute’ (?), ገብረ, which I take as ግብር ‘work, service’ written with ገ- (ገብር is ‘servant’) (?), ጸባሕተ ‘morning offering’ (?), a guess from ጸባሕ ‘morning’. ወትማስን ‘and it will perish’ (ማሰነ ‘perish’). The lads argue that if the people see weakness, the gifts and dues will stop, and the kingdom will perish.

sentences.i: Rather, speak to them with a strong word and harshly, saying, ‘As for my father, you said of him that he burdened you with wood and stone, but I shall subdue (?) you with whips and scorpions. For my little finger is stronger than the thickness of my father, and my counsel is greater than the counsel of my father who begot me. I shall take nothing from your work and your burden (?); I shall only add to it for you in everything;
sentences.n: አላ ‘but’; በሎሙ ‘say to them’; በጽኑዕ ቃል ‘with a strong word’ and በገንሕ ‘with harshness’ (ገንሕ ‘harshness’ (?)). The speech is that of 1 Kings 12:10–11 (‘my little finger is thicker than my father’s loins… my father chastised you with whips, but I will chastise you with scorpions’). አቡየሰ ትቤልዎ ‘as for my father, you said of him’: ትቤልዎ is 2mp ትቤሉ (the prefix form of ይቤ used as a perfect, as ትቤ in ch. 69) + ሎ ‘to, of him’ (as in ይቤልዎ ‘they said to him’), not an object -ዎ; በዕፅ ወበእብን has no verb, and ‘burdened you’ is supplied from the people’s complaint in unit 6. እቀንየክሙ ‘I will subdue you’: the prefix እ- is the plain G imperfect (a causative would be ኣቀንይ-), so either ቀነየ (‘serve’) is itself used transitively here or the form is irregular; the sense is from the context (?). ጋጋት ‘whips’ and ዐቃርብት ‘scorpions’ are plurals. ቊጠጠ ዚአየ ‘my little finger’ is uncertain (?). ግዝፈ ‘thickness, bulk’ + አብ. የዐቢ ‘is greater’; ወእምክሩ ለአቡየ ‘and than the counsel of my father’: እም- ‘than’ + ምክር + -ሁ ‘his’ anticipating the genitive ለአቡየ, with one ም written (?). ዘኣነትግ: ነተገ ‘remove, take away’ is uncertain (?); ገብጋብ ‘burden’ (?). ዘኣፈደፍድ ‘what I shall add’ (አፈድፈደ). Note the lads’ counsel is the very speech quoted by the historical Rehoboam.

sentences.i: But if you do not listen to my word and do not do my command, I shall make your cattle tethered, and your children shall become slaves; my knife (?) shall devour you, and I shall take your cities, your enclosures, your gardens, your wells, your fields, and enclosures and your fruit (?);
sentences.n: ወለእመኒ ‘and if’ (ለእመ + -ኒ); ኢሰማዕክሙ ‘you (pl.) did not hear’. እገብር እንስሳክሙ ሕብልያ: ሕብልያ is obscure; I take ‘bound, tethered’ (?), as of animals led off. ፄዋወለክሙኒ is one word in the source: ፄዋ ‘captives, slaves’ (as in ch. 60) + ወ- ‘and’ + ለክሙ ‘to you’ + -ኒ, ‘slaves; and as for you’; ይከውኑ ‘they will be’. መጥባኅትየ is መጥባሕት ‘knife’ (ch. 30 has the plural መጣብሕ) + -የ ‘my’, a feminine singular, hence the 3fs verb ትበልዐክሙ ‘it will devour you’ (በልዐ ‘swallow, devour’); the spelling with ኅ is irregular (?). The list of possessions is all with the suffix -ክሙ ‘your (pl.)’: አህጉር ‘cities’, አዕጻድ ‘enclosures, courts’, አትክልት ‘gardens’, ዐዘቃት ‘wells’ (?), ገራውህ ‘fields’, and ወአዕጻዳተ ወፍርክሙ ‘and enclosures and your fruit’ (ወ- + ፍር ‘fruit’ + -ክሙ; አዕጻዳተ has no suffix and I do not take it as a construct) (?).

sentences.n: እስመ ኵላ ዘይእቲ ምድር ‘for the whole of this land’ (ኵላ + ዘይእቲ ‘this (f.)’); ተውህበት ‘it was given’, the passive of ወሀበ; መንግሥት ‘kingdom’. ለአበ አቡየ ‘to the father of my father’ is a construct chain. ወሊተኒ ‘and to me also’ (ሊተ ‘to me’ + -ኒ). sentences.i: The one who reigned on the throne of his father David is Jesus Christ, his kinsman in the flesh, from a virgin, and who sits on the throne of his divinity;
sentences.n: ዘነግሠ ‘he who reigned’; the antecedent is ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ, and the answer to the promise of the psalms is that the true heir is Christ. ዘመዱ በሥጋ እምድንግል ‘his kinsman in the flesh, from a virgin’ (ዘመድ ‘kinsman, kin’ + -ሁ; the ዘ is part of the noun, not a relative); the descent from David through Mary (Luke 1:32–33). ዘነበረ ‘who sat’ (the perfect, here with the sense of the permanent state); መለኮቱ ‘his divinity’ (መለኮት + -ሁ). The Zion/Ark theology of the book treats the earthly kingdom as the shadow of the heavenly.

sentences.i: From the descendants of Jeroboam the generations ran down to Joachim, forty-one in all; and then two sons were born to Melki, Levi and Shem, the father of Honase (?);
sentences.n: ወእምትውልደ ‘and from the descent of’ (ትውልድ ‘generation’); ኮነት ትውልድ ‘there was a generation’; እስከ ‘until’. ኢያቄም is Joachim, father of Mary in the tradition (the Protevangelium of James); the text counts forty-one generations from Solomon’s son (ኢዮርብዓም here, Rehoboam in the heading) to him, in the numeral ፵ወ፩ (spoken አርብዓ ወአሐዱ, arbəʿa wä-ʾähadu, ‘forty-one’). ወአሜሃ ‘and then’. ተወልዱ ‘they were born’; ለመልኪ ‘to Melki’ (a name, Melchi in Luke 3:24); ክልኤ ‘two’ (the short form of ክልኤቱ before a noun) with the plural ደቂቅ ‘sons’. ወላዴ ሆናሴ ‘and begetter of Honase’ (ወላዲ ‘begetter’, construct); the names correspond loosely to Luke’s genealogy. The names and sequence differ from the Gospels, and my reading of the apposition is uncertain (?).

sentences.n: ወካዕበ ‘and again’. A second chain of names, ኢሊ, ሜልኪ, ማቲ (ማቴ), ኤሊ, ያዕቆብ, and ሐና ‘Hanna’, wife of Joachim, thus Mary’s mother and Jacob’s sister. ወለዶ ‘he begot him’, ወለዶሙ ‘he begot them’: -ኦ and -ሙ as object suffixes. The names Eli and Jacob are those of Joseph’s fathers in Luke 3:23 and Matthew 1:16.

sentences.l: And-Eli took-a-wife and-died while there-is-not children, and-Jacob took-her, the-wife-of Eli, Yohada, and-begot by-her Joseph, carpenter, who betrothed Mary.
sentences.i: Eli took a wife and died without children, and Jacob took Eli’s wife Yohada and begot by her Joseph the carpenter, who betrothed Mary (?).
sentences.n: ወአውሰበ ‘he took a wife’ (አውሰበ ‘marry’); እንዘ አልቦ ውሉደ ‘while there were no children’. ወአውሰባ ‘he took her to wife’ is the levirate marriage (Deuteronomy 25:5–6): Jacob marries his dead brother’s widow, and the son Joseph is legally Eli’s. ዮሐዳ ‘Yohada’ names the widow (?). ጸራቤ ‘carpenter’ (ጸራቢ); ዘፈኀራ ለማርያም ‘who betrothed Mary’: ዘ- + ፈኀረ (3ms perfect, active) + -ኣ ‘her’, with ለማርያም restating the object; the verb I cannot confirm and ‘betrothed’ is from the context (?), so the passive of the Gospels is not what the form says. The reconciling of Matthew 1:16 (Jacob) and Luke 3:23 (Eli) by levirate marriage is an old explanation (Julius Africanus).

sentences.i: Joseph was the son of Jacob by flesh and the son of Eli by the Law of the Torah, as God commanded Moses that they should marry among their own kin, each within the houses of their fathers, and not marry from a foreign kin.
sentences.n: ወዮሴፍሰ ‘and Joseph indeed’; ወልደ ‘son of’ (construct). The text writes በሥጋወወልደኤሊ without word division for በሥጋ ወወልደ ኤሊ ‘in flesh and son of Eli’ (the source text joins them). በሕገ ኦሪት ‘by the law of the Torah’; በከመ አዘዞ ‘as he commanded him’; ይትዋሰቡ ‘they marry one another’ (tä-stem of ወሰበ); ምስለ ዘመዶሙ ‘with their kin’; በበ አብያተ አበዊሆሙ ‘each by the houses of their fathers’, which alludes to Numbers 36:6–9, the rule that heiresses marry within their tribe. ኢይትዋሰቡ እምባዕድ ዘመድ ‘they shall not intermarry from a foreign kin’. The row ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ marks the end of the chapter and stays with the last unit.

glossary.ሐዊረ: ሐዊር — going (verbal noun of ሖረ, accusative; 'to go')
glossary.ሕመቅ: ሕመቅ (?) — weakness (?) (noun); form and sense unclear, read from the parallel ድካም
glossary.ሕብልያ: ሕብል — bonds, bondmen (noun, rope, cord; ሕብልያ read as a predicate plural 'bondmen' after ኮኑ); form and sense uncertain (?) · or 'tethered, bound' (?)
glossary.ሕዝበከ: ሕዝብ — your people (noun, accusative + -ከ '2ms your'; apposition to Israel)
glossary.መለኮቱ: መለኮት — his divinity, godhead (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', form መለኮቱ)
glossary.መላህቅተ: መልህቅ — anchor (plural መላህቅት; construct መላህቅተ, subject here); here figuratively 'stays, elders', the sense taken from context, 'elders of' (?) · or construct plural of ልሂቅ 'elder', 'elders of'
glossary.መማክርት: መምከር — counsellors (plural መማክርት; singular not confirmed)
glossary.መከሩ: መከረ — they took counsel (3mp perfect, G, m-k-r)
glossary.መዋዕለ: ዕለት — day (noun, plural መዋዕል 'days', accusative / construct)
glossary.መጥባኅትየ: መጥባሕት — my knife (feminine singular, spelled with ኅ; plural መጣብሕ) + -የ 'my'
glossary.ማእምረ: ማእምር — knower of (agent noun, construct of ማእምር, from አእመረ 'know')
glossary.ም: ዓለም — the closing letter of ዓለም (ለዓለ ም 'for ever'), split off by a print break (not a word)
glossary.ምሁራነ: ምሁር — taught ones, trained ones (plural ምሁራን, construct 'trained in')
glossary.ሥሩዕ: ሥሩዕ — ordered, set in order (adj./passive participle of ሠርዐ)
glossary.ርሡኣን: ርሡእ — old men, elders (plural ርሡኣን; lemma and sense from context) (?)
glossary.ርእዩ: ርእየ — see! (2mp imperative) · they saw (3mp perfect, ሶበ ርእዩ 'when they saw'; ch. 53)
glossary.ሰመይዎ: ሰመየ — they called him (3mp perfect, G 'name, call' + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ሰረገላ: ሰረገላ — chariot (noun) · also 'cart' for the vehicle that carries the Ark among the baggage (ውስተ ሰረገላ 'onto a cart')
glossary.ሰርጐ: ሰርጕ — adornment (noun; construct 'adornment of') · also 'wedding, giving in marriage' (?)
glossary.ሰቡዐ: ሰቡዕ — week; also reckoned as 'seven' (noun, accusative ሰቡዐ), here with መዋዕለ 'a week of days, seven days' (?)
glossary.ሰናስለ: ሰንሰለት — chains (ሰናስል, plural of ሰንሰለት; construct ሰናስለ 'chains of')
glossary.በሎሙ: ብህለ — say to them (imperative በል of ብህለ, ይቤ 'say' + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.በሐጢበ: ሐጠበ (?) — by cutting, hewing (?) (verbal noun, construct: በ- + ሐጢብ 'cutting of', from ሐጠበ 'hew (wood)' (?)); construct before ዕፅ
glossary.በሕገ: ሕግ — by the law of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በምልኦሙ: ምልኣት — in their fullness, all together (በ- + ምልኣት 'fullness' + -ሙ 'their')
glossary.በሥጋወወልደኤሊ: ሥጋ — in flesh and son of Eli (one word for በ- + ሥጋ 'flesh' + ወ- 'and' + ወልደ 'son of' + ኤሊ 'Eli')
glossary.በስመ: ስም — by the name of (በ- 'by, in' + construct 'name of')
glossary.በቃል: ቃል — in word, by word (በ- + ቃል 'word', noun)
glossary.በቅለ: በቅል — mule (accusative, predicate of ኮነ); the same word stands beside አድግ/ዓድግ 'ass' elsewhere in the text
glossary.በቅድመ: ቅድመ — before, in the presence of (በ- + preposition)
glossary.በበ: በበ — each, every, by (distributive, doubled preposition በ-)
glossary.በቤተ: ቤት — in the house of (በ- + noun, construct)
glossary.በትር: በትር — staff, rod (noun); here a rod standing for a tribe
glossary.በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
glossary.በእደ: እድ — by the hand of (በ- + noun, construct; plural stem አእዳው)
glossary.በከመ: ከመ — as, in the way that (በ- 'in' + ከመ)
glossary.በውስተቤተ: ውስተ — in the house of (one word: በውስተ 'in, within' + ቤተ, construct of ቤት 'house')
glossary.በውእቱ: ውእቱ — in that (በ- + demonstrative, before መዋዕል 'days')
glossary.በዕፅ: ዕፅ — with wood (በ- + ዕፅ 'wood, tree', noun)
glossary.በጽኑዕ: ጽኑዕ — with strong (በ- + ጽኑዕ 'strong, firm', adjective)
glossary.ባሕ: ባሕ — unidentified; apparently an interjection of greeting before ሕየው (?)
glossary.ቤተከ: ቤት — your house (noun, accusative, stem ቤተ- + -ከ '2ms your')
glossary.ብእሲተ: ብእሲት — woman, wife (noun, fem., construct / accusative)
glossary.ተሐፅኑ: ሐፀነ — they were reared, nursed (3mp perfect, tä-stem passive of ሐፀነ 'nurse, rear') (?)
glossary.ተናገሮሙ: ተናገረ — speak to them (2ms imperative, tä-stem of ነገረ + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ተከፍለት: ከፈለ — it was divided (3fs perfect, tä-stem passive of ከፈለ)
glossary.ተወልዱ: ተወልደ — they were born (3mp perfect, passive/reflexive of ወለደ)
glossary.ተውህበት: ተውህበ — she was given (3fs perfect, passive of ወሀበ; subject ታቦት)
glossary.ትበልዐክሙ: በልዐ — it will devour you (3fs imperfect, G 'eat, devour' + -ክሙ 'you', 2mp)
glossary.ትቤልዎ: ብህለ — you said of/to him (2mp ትቤሉ, prefix form with perfect sense + ሎ 'to him', written -ልዎ); ልዎ is ሎ, not an object -ዎ
glossary.ትብል: ብህለ — she says (3fs imperfect, after እንዘ 'saying') · 2ms 'you say' (ሶበ ጸብሐ ትብል 'when it is morning you say')
glossary.ትእዛዝየ: ትእዛዝ — commandment (noun, singular, possibly collective; from አዘዘ; + -የ 'my', 1cs)
glossary.ትጽናዕ: ጸንዐ (?) — that it be strong (3fs subjunctive); vowel pattern unusual (?)
glossary.ኀለፈ: ኀለፈ — he/it passed away (3ms perfect, G, ḫ-l-f)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀጺን: ኀጺን — iron (noun; በአፈ ኀጺን 'by the edge of iron', i.e. the sword)
glossary.ኅቡረ: ኅቡር — together (accusative as adverb; from ኅብረ/ኅቡር)
glossary.ነሥኦ: ነሥአ — he took him (3ms perfect, G + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ናባጥ: ናባጥ — Nebat (proper name, father of Jeroboam)
glossary.ንልሀቅ: ልህቀ — that we grow great (1cp subjunctive, G 'grow, be great')
glossary.ንከውን: ኮነ — we shall be (1cp imperf., k-w-n)
glossary.ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አህጉሪክሙ: ሀገር — your cities (አህጉር, plural of ሀገር, with linking -ኢ- + -ክሙ 'your')
glossary.አልብነኑ: አልቦ — is there not to us? (አልቦ 'there is not' + -ነ 'to us' + -ኑ interrogative)
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አምከርዎ: አምከረ (?) — they counselled him (3mp perfect, causative-type of መከረ + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.አረጋዊ: አረጋዊ — old man, elder (noun); plural አእሩግ
glossary.አቅልል: አቅለለ — make light, lighten (2ms imperative, causative of ቀለለ)
glossary.አበይናሆሙ: አበየ — we refused them (1cp perfect, G + -ሆሙ 'them')
glossary.አቡከ: አብ — father (noun, genitive after construct; + -ከ 'your', 2ms, form አቡ-)
glossary.አቡየሰ: አብ — as for my father (አብ 'father', stem አቡ- + -የ 'my' + -ሰ 'indeed, as for')
glossary.አንገፍዎ: አንገፈ (?) — they made him cease, put an end to (?) (3mp perfect + -ዎ 'him'); verb unidentified, sense from context
glossary.አእሩግ: አረጋዊ — old men, elders (plural of አረጋዊ; construct before ምክር)
glossary.አክበደ: አክበደ — he made heavy, burdened (3ms perfect, causative of ከበደ 'be heavy')
glossary.አውሥኦሙ: አውሥአ — he answered them (3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them', causative of ወሥአ, w-ś-ʾ) · or 'answer them' (2ms imperative; same spelling)
glossary.አዕረፈ: አዕረፈ — he rested, died, reposed (3ms perfect, causative አ- stem, r-f)
glossary.አይሁድ: አይሁድ — the Jews (noun, plural; the dependent noun after the construct ሕዝበ)
glossary.አግብርትየ: ገብር — my servants (አግብርት, plural of ገብር 'servant' + -የ 'my')
glossary.ኢሰማዕክሙ: ሰምዐ — you did not hear (ኢ- + 2mp perfect, G)
glossary.ኢተሐሰ: ሐሰወ (?) — was not proved false (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem of ሐሰወ 'lie') (?)
glossary.ኢታርእዮሙ: አርአየ — do not show them (ኢ- + 2ms jussive, causative of ርእየ + -ሙ 'them'); prohibitive
glossary.ኢወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he did not give him (ኢ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ኢየቄ: ኢያቄም (?) — Iyeqe-, first half of ኢያቄም 'Joachim' split by a wordspace (?) (proper name)
glossary.ኢያምስሉ: አምሰለ — lest they liken, suppose (ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, causative of መሰለ); clause uncertain (?)
glossary.ኢያምስሉከ: አምሰለ — lest they liken you, think you (ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive, causative of መሰለ + -ከ 'you')
glossary.ኢያፀርዓ: አፀረዐ (?) — let him not annul it (?) (ኢ- + 3ms jussive, causative + -ኣ 'it', f.); verb uncertain
glossary.ኢይበሉነ: ብህለ — that they not call us (ኢ- + 3mp subjunctive of ብህለ, ይቤ 'say' + -ነ 'us')
glossary.ኢዮርብዓም: ኢዮርብዓም — Jeroboam (proper name) · also Solomon's son as well as the Ephraimite
glossary.ኣነብር: አነበረ — I will set, place (1cs imperfect, causative of ነበረ; written ኣነብር)
glossary.ኤፍራታ: ኤፍራታ — Ephrata (proper name; here Ephraim's territory (?))
glossary.እምባዕድ: ባዕድ — from a foreign, other (እም- 'from' + ባዕድ 'other, foreign', adjective)
glossary.እምኀበ: ኀበ — from (እም- 'from' + ኀበ; 'from the side of')
glossary.እምኔሆሙ: እም — from them, out of them (preposition + 3mp suffix, stem እምኔ-)
glossary.እምግዝፈ: ግዝፍ — than the thickness of (እም- 'than, from' + ግዝፈ 'thickness, bulk', construct)
glossary.እምፍሬ: ፍሬ — from the fruit of (እም- + noun, construct)
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እቀንየክሙ: ቀነየ (?) — I will subdue, make serve (?) you (1cs imperfect + -ክሙ 'you', 2mp); sense from context
glossary.እንስሳክሙ: እንስሳ — your cattle, beasts (እንስሳ, collective noun + -ክሙ 'your', 2mp)
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.እገብር: ገብረ — I do, make (1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ኦሪት: ኦሪት — the Torah, the Law (noun); ሕገ ኦሪት 'law of the Torah'
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ክልኤ: ክልኤቱ — two (numeral; the short form ክልኤ before a noun)
glossary.ክቡራንየ: ክቡር — my honoured ones, nobles (plural ክቡራን + -የ 'my')
glossary.ኮነት: ኮነ — become, be (3fs perfect; subject መንግሥተ)
glossary.ኵላ: ኵሉ — all, the whole (variant form ኵላ, accusative)
glossary.ኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — all of them (+ -omu) · before a noun, 'all' (ኵሎሙ አድያመ ኢትዮጵያ 'all the regions of Ethiopia', ch. 55)
glossary.ወ: ወ — and (conjunction, written as a separate word before ይቤሉ) · also a separate word before በደኃሪ ባሕር ('and in the last sea')
glossary.ወሀበኒ: ወሀበ — he gave me (3ms perfect, G + -ኒ '1cs me')
glossary.ወሀበከ: ወሀበ — he gave you (3ms perfect, G + -ከ 'you', 2ms)
glossary.ወሀቦ: ወሀበ — he gave him (3ms perfect + -ኦ 3ms object) · with the -ኦ anticipating a ለ- phrase (ወሀቦ ለወልዱ 'he gave him, to his son')
glossary.ወለሐና: ሐና — and Hanna (ወ- + ለ- + proper name); ለ- marks the object
glossary.ወለሕዝበ: ሕዝብ — and to the people of (ወ- + ለ- + ሕዝበ, construct of ሕዝብ 'people')
glossary.ወለንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and to the king of (ወ- + ለ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወለአቡየ: አብ — and to my father (ወ- + ለ- + አብ 'father', stem አቡ- + -የ 'my')
glossary.ወለአብዕልቲክሙኒ: ባዕል — and for your rich ones, also (ወ- + ለ- + አብዕልት plural of ባዕል 'rich' + -ክሙ 'your' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወለእመኒ: ለእመ — and even if (ወ- 'and' + ለእመ 'if' + enclitic -ኒ 'even')
glossary.ወለክቡራኒክሙ: ክቡር — and for your honoured ones (ወ- + ለ- + ክቡራን plural of ክቡር 'honoured, noble', linking vowel + -ክሙ 'your')
glossary.ወለዘሠምረት: ሠምረ — and for whom … was pleased (ወ- + ለ- + ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, G 'be pleased, please')
glossary.ወለያዕቆብ: ያዕቆብ — and Jacob (ወ- + ለ- + proper name); ለ- marks the object
glossary.ወለዮርበዓምሰ: ዮርብዓም — and as for Jeroboam (ወ- + ለ- + proper name, spelled ዮርበዓም + -ሰ 'indeed, as for')
glossary.ወለዮርብዓምኒ: ዮርብዓም — and Jeroboam also (ወ- + ለ- + proper name + -ኒ 'also'); ለ- doubles the object
glossary.ወለደ: ወለደ — he begot, bore (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወለዳ: ወለደ — he begot her (3ms perfect, G + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወለዶ: ወለደ — and he begot him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወለዶሙ: ወለደ — and he begot them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወሊተኒ: ሊተ — and to me also (ወ- + ሊተ '1s to me' + enclitic -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወላሐውዎ: ላሐ — and they lamented him (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G of ላሐ 'lament' + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወላዕለ: ላዕለ — and against (ወ- + preposition ላዕለ 'upon, over, against')
glossary.ወላዴ: ወላዲ — and begetter of (ወ- + ወላዲ 'begetter, father', construct ወላዴ, from ወለደ)
glossary.ወልሂቅ: ልሂቅ — and an elder, great one (ወ- + ልሂቅ, noun); plural ልሂቃን, መላህቅት
glossary.ወመላህቅት: ልሂቅ — and elders (ወ- + መላህቅት, plural of ልሂቅ 'elder, great one'); not መልህቅ 'anchor'
glossary.ወመከረ: መከረ — and he took counsel (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወማቴ: ማቴ — and Mate (ወ- + proper name, variant of ማቲ)
glossary.ወሜልኪ: ሜልኪ — and Melki (ወ- + proper name, variant of መልኪ)
glossary.ወምጒንጳሁ: ምጒንጳ (?) — and his quiver (?) (ወ- + noun ምጒንጳ + -ሁ 'his'); sense a guess
glossary.ወሞተ: ሞተ — and he died (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-w-t)
glossary.ወረከቦ: ረከበ — and he found him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ዎ 'him') · the object suffix is -ኦ 'him' (ረከበ + ኦ, contracted -ቦ), not -ዎ
glossary.ወርሡእሂ: ርሡእ — and an aged man too (ወ- + ርሡእ 'aged, old man' + -ሂ 'also'); plural ርሡኣን
glossary.ወርኅ: ወርኅ — moon, month (noun; construct 'of the moon')
glossary.ወቀብኦ: ቀብአ — and he anointed him (ወ- + G 3ms perf. with suffix 3ms -ኦ)
glossary.ወቃለ: ቃል — and the word of (ወ- + noun, construct 'word of')
glossary.ወበሎሙ: ብህለ — and say to them (ወ- + imperative በል of ብህለ, ይቤ 'say' + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወበምድርኒ: ምድር — and on earth also (ወ- + በ- + noun + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወበምግባር: ምግባር — and in deed (ወ- + በ- + ምግባር 'deed, act', noun)
glossary.ወበቤተ: ቤት — and from the house of (ወ- + በ- + ቤተ, construct of ቤት 'house')
glossary.ወበአቅሞ: አቆመ — and by setting up (ወ- + በ- + infinitive አቅሞ of አቆመ 'set up', construct)
glossary.ወበእብን: እብን — and with stone (ወ- + በ- + እብን 'stone', noun)
glossary.ወበእንተ: በእንተ — and concerning, about (ወ- + preposition) · and on account of, because of (ወበእንተ እከዮሙ 'and because of their evil')
glossary.ወበውቅረተ: ውቅረት (?) — and by heaping up (?) (ወ- + በ- + verbal noun ውቅረት, construct); perhaps from ወቀረ 'pierce, dig out', i.e. 'quarrying' (?)
glossary.ወበዐቃርብት: ዐቅራብ — and with scorpions (ወ- + በ- + ዐቃርብት, plural of ዐቅራብ 'scorpion')
glossary.ወበዝንቱሰ: ዝንቱ — and in this, as for this (ወ- + በ- + demonstrative + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወበገንሕ: ገንሕ (?) — and with harshness (?) (ወ- + በ- + ገንሕ, noun)
glossary.ወበጽሐ: በጽሐ — and he reached (ወ- + 3ms perfect, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ወበጽሑ: በጽሐ — and they arrived (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወቤተ: ቤት — and the house of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወቦእምኔሆሙ: ቦ — and there is among them (ወ- + ቦ 'there is' + እምኔሆሙ 'from them'), written as one word
glossary.ወተነፍሐ: ተነፍሐ — and was blown (ወ- + 3ms perfect passive, tä-stem of ነፍሐ, n-f-ḥ)
glossary.ወተንሥኡ: ተንሥአ — and they arose (ወ- + 3mp perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተአዘዙ: አዘዘ — and obey (ወ- + 2mp imperative, tä-stem of አዘዘ 'command')
glossary.ወተዓፀዉ: ዐፀወ (?) — and they … (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem); the nearest real root ዐፀወ means 'shut, enclose', 'cast lots' is a guess from ዕፃ
glossary.ወተጋብኡ: ተጋብአ — and they assembled (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወትማስን: ማሰነ — and it will perish (ወ- + 3fs imperfect, G 'perish')
glossary.ወኀረዩ: ኀረየ — and they chose (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወነገሮሙ: ነገረ — and he told them (ወ- + 3ms perfect + -ሙ '3mp them', G)
glossary.ወናነግሥ: አንገሠ — and we shall make king (ወ- + 1cp imperfect, causative of ነግሠ)
glossary.ወንጉሠሮምሂ: ንጉሥ — and the king of Rome too (one word: ወ- + ንጉሠ, construct of ንጉሥ 'king' + ሮም 'Rome' + -ሂ 'also')
glossary.ወአሜሃ: አሜሃ — and then, at that time (ወ- + adverb)
glossary.ወአቡከኒ: አብ — and your father also (ወ- + አብ 'father' + -ከ 'your' + -ኒ 'also'; stem አቡ-)
glossary.ወአብኦሙ: አብአ — and he brought them in (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ቦአ + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወአንሰ: አነ — and as for me (ወ- 'and' + 1s pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአንስትያክሙኒ: ብእሲት — and your women, also (ወ- + አንስት plural of ብእሲት 'woman', with linking -ያ- + -ክሙ 'your' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወአንበረ: አንበረ — and he placed (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ነበረ)
glossary.ወአንተሰ: አንተ — and as for you (ወ- + 2ms pronoun + emphatic -ሰ)
glossary.ወአንገለጉ: አንገለጉ (?) — and they … (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect); unclear, perhaps 'held back, considered'
glossary.ወአንገሥዎ: አንገሠ — and they made him king (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ነግሠ + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወአንገሦ: አንገሠ — and he made him king (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ነግሠ + -ኦ 'him', contracted -ሦ)
glossary.ወአውሰበ: አውሰበ — and he married (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሰበ; of a man taking a wife)
glossary.ወአውሰባ: አውሰበ — and he took her to wife (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወሰበ 'marry' + -ኣ 'her')
glossary.ወአውፅኦሙ: አውጽአ — and he sent them out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ወጽአ + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ወአዕጻዲክሙ: ዐጸድ — and your enclosures (ወ- + አዕጻድ, plural of ዐጸድ 'enclosure, court', + linking -ኢ- + -ክሙ 'your')
glossary.ወአዕጻዳተ: ዐጸድ — and enclosures, courts (ወ- + አዕጻዳት plural of ዐጸድ, accusative; no suffix)
glossary.ወአጽዐንዎ: አጽዐነ — and they mounted him (ወ- + causative 3mp perf. of ጸዐነ 'load, mount' with suffix 3ms -ዎ)
glossary.ወኢተርፎ: ተርፈ — and there remained not to him (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect, G 'remain' + -ኦ 'him', written -ፎ)
glossary.ወኢያሐጽጻ: አሐጸጸ — and let him not diminish it (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms jussive, causative of ሐጸጸ + -ኣ 'it', f.)
glossary.ወኢያቄምኒ: ኢያቄም — and Joachim also (ወ- + proper name + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወኢያበጥላ: አበጠለ — and let him not make void it (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms jussive, causative of በጠለ + -ኣ 'it', f.)
glossary.ወኢይሁቡነ: ወሀበ — and let them not give us (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp jussive, G + -ነ 'us')
glossary.ወኢይሜቊሳ: መቈሰ (?) — and let him not … it (?) (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms jussive + -ኣ 'it'); verb not identified, 'mar' a guess; not ወቈሰ 'wound', whose imperfect is ይወቍስ
glossary.ወኢይትዋሰቡ: ወሰበ — and they shall not intermarry (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp jussive, tä-stem of ወሰበ)
glossary.ወኢይኔስሕ: ነስሐ — and he will not repent (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect ይኔስሕ, G)
glossary.ወኢገበርክሙ: ገብረ — and you did not do (ወ- + ኢ- + 2mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወኢገብረ: ገብረ — and he did not do/make (ወ- 'and' + ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r) · or the noun ግብር 'service, work' written ገብረ, 'and not service' (?)
glossary.ወኢጸባሕተ: ጽባሕ (?) — and not morning-offering (?) (ወ- + ኢ- + ጸባሕተ, from ጽባሕ 'morning'); sense a guess
glossary.ወእሉኒ: እሉ — and these (ወ- + እሉ 'these' + -ኒ 'also', demonstrative plural)
glossary.ወእመሰ: እመ — and if (ወ- 'and' + conditional conjunction + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
glossary.ወእምትውልደ: ትውልድ — and from the descent of (ወ- + እም- 'from' + ትውልደ, construct of ትውልድ 'generation, descent')
glossary.ወእምክሩ: ምክር — and than his counsel (ወ- + እም- 'than' + ምክር 'counsel' + -ሁ 'his', contracted -ሩ), anticipating ለአቡየ (?)
glossary.ወእቀንየክሙ: ቀነየ (?) — and I will subdue (?) you (ወ- + 1cs imperfect + -ክሙ 'you', 2mp); sense from context
glossary.ወእነሥእ: ነሥአ — and I will take (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G)
glossary.ወእከትባ: ከተበ — and I will write it (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G + -ኣ 'it', f.)
glossary.ወእገብራ: ገብረ — and I will do it (ወ- + 1cs imperfect, G + -ኣ 'it', f.)
glossary.ወከመ: ከመ — that, so that (conjunction; ወ- 'and') · and as (ወከመ ዝ 'and as this') · 'and like' before a noun (ወከመ ድምፀ አንበሳ 'and like the voice of a lion')
glossary.ወወለደ: ወለደ — and he begot (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-l-d)
glossary.ወወሬዛሰ: ወሬዛ — and the lad indeed (ወ- + ወሬዛ 'lad, youth' + -ሰ 'indeed, as for'); plural ወራዙት
glossary.ወወሰክዎ: ወሰከ — and they brought him, added him to (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G + -ዎ 'him'); the published parts read ወሰከ 'add'
glossary.ወዐዘቃቲክሙ: ዐዘቅት (?) — and your wells (?) (ወ- + ዐዘቃት, plural of ዐዘቅት 'well, pit', + -ክሙ 'your')
glossary.ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
glossary.ወዘኢትክል: ክህለ — and (one) who is not able (ወ- + ዘ- relative + ኢ- + 2ms imperfect of ይክል)
glossary.ወዘከመሂ: ዘከመ — and however, in whatever way (ወ- 'and' + ዘከመ 'as, how' + enclitic -ሂ)
glossary.ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይእዜሰ: ይእዜ — and now, as for (ወ- 'and' + adverb 'now' + contrastive enclitic -ሰ 'as for, but')
glossary.ወዮሴፍሰ: ዮሴፍ — and Joseph indeed (ወ- + proper name + -ሰ 'indeed, as for')
glossary.ወደምፀት: ደምፀ — and it sounded, resounded (ወ- + 3fs perfect, d-m-ṣ; subject ሀገር) (?) · subject also ፈለገ ግብጽ 'river of Egypt' (ch. 55)
glossary.ወደቂቅክሙ: ደቂቅ — and your children (ወ- + ደቂቅ 'children, sons' (plural of ወልድ) + -ክሙ 'your')
glossary.ወገራውሂክሙ: ገራህት — and your fields (ወ- + ገራውህ, plural of ገራህት 'field', + -ክሙ 'your')
glossary.ወገብረ: ገብረ — and he did (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ወገብጋበ: ገብጋብ (?) — and burden (?) (ወ- + ገብጋብ, noun, accusative); uncertain
glossary.ወጋዳ: ጋዳ — unidentified word, perhaps a kind of gift (ወ- 'and') (?)
glossary.ወጐዩ: ጐየ — and they fled (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወጾሩ: ጾረ — and they bore, carried (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወፍርክሙ: ፍሬ — and your fruit (ወ- + ፍር, construct/short form of ፍሬ 'fruit', + -ክሙ 'your')
glossary.ውእቱ: ውእቱ — he, it (3ms independent pronoun; also serves as copula 'is')
glossary.ዕንቡዛን: ዕንቡዝ (?) — youths, tender young men (?) (plural -ዛን of ዕንቡዝ)
glossary.ዘለአኩ: ለአከ — what they sent (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ዘመድ: ዘመድ — kinsman, kin, relative (noun; the ዘ is part of the stem, not a relative)
glossary.ዘበሕጉ: ሕግ — what is by his law (ዘ- 'that which' + በ- 'by' + ሕግ 'law' + -ሁ 'his', contracted -ጉ)
glossary.ዘቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')
glossary.ዘተረክበ: ተረክበ — who was found (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, passive of ረከበ)
glossary.ዘትብል: ብህለ — what you say (ዘ- + 2ms imperfect ትብል, b-h-l)
glossary.ዘትፈቅዱ: ፈቀደ — what you wish (ዘ- relative + 2mp imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘኀረዩ: ኀረየ — whom they chose (ዘ- relative + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ዘነበረ: ነበረ — who sat, dwelt (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ዘነግሠ: ነግሠ — he who reigned, that he reigned (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G); ዘ- + perfect also nominalizes 'him who reigned'
glossary.ዘናነግሥ: አንገሠ — whom we shall make king (ዘ- relative + 1cp imperfect, causative of ነግሠ)
glossary.ዘኢያጽንዐ: አጽንዐ — who has not made firm (ዘ- relative + ኢ- + 3ms of the causative of ጸንዐ 'be strong', written ያጽንዐ with final -ä; perfect sense, spelling unusual (?))
glossary.ዘኢይክል: ክህለ — who is not able (ዘ- relative + ኢ- + 3ms imperfect of ይክል 'be able')
glossary.ዘኣነትግ: ነተገ (?) — what I will remove, take away (?) (ዘ- relative + 1cs imperfect, G); verb uncertain
glossary.ዘኣፈደፍድ: አፈድፈደ — what I will add (ዘ- relative + 1cs imperfect, causative of ፈድፈደ 'abound, exceed')
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘከማሁ: ከማሁ — one like him (ዘ- relative + ከማሁ 'like him')
glossary.ዘከማከ: ከማ — like you (ዘ- + ከማ 'like' + -ከ 'you', 2ms); ዘ- here forms the adjective 'such as you'
glossary.ዘይመልኅ: መልኀ — who draws (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G 'draw (a sword)')
glossary.ዘይሰርር: ሰረረ — which flies (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect); root and sense from context (?) · or 'who speeds ahead' (?)
glossary.ዘይቀልብ: ቀለበ (?) — who swings, brandishes (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect); verb and sense uncertain
glossary.ዘይቤሎ: ብህለ — what he said to him (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect ይቤ + -ሎ 'to him')
glossary.ዘይነግሥ: ነግሠ — who reigns (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘይንእስ: ንእሰ — who is younger, small (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, n-ʾ-s)
glossary.ዘይእቲ: ይእቲ — this, that (f.) (ዘ- + ይእቲ, demonstrative; ዘይእቲ ምድር 'this land')
glossary.ዘይእኅዝ: አኀዘ — who holds, seizes (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘገብረ: ገብረ — what he did (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, g-b-r)
glossary.ዘፈቀድነ: ፈቀደ — whom/what we wished (ዘ- relative + 1cp perfect, G)
glossary.ዘፈቀድከ: ፈቀደ — what you wished (ዘ- + 2ms perfect, G, f-q-d)
glossary.ዘፈኀራ: ፈኀረ (?) — who betrothed her (?) (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect, G + -ኣ 'her'); verb unconfirmed
glossary.የዐቢ: ዐበየ — he is great, greater (3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ያንግሡ: አንገሠ — that they make king (3mp subjunctive, causative of ነግሠ)
glossary.ይትዋሰቡ: ወሰበ — they marry one another (3mp subjunctive, tä-stem of ወሰበ)
glossary.ይከውኑ: ኮነ — they will be (3mp imperfect, G, k-w-n)
glossary.ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ይግባእ: ገብአ — that he return (3ms subjunctive, G, after ከመ) · or 'that he enter, go in', after ዘእንበለ 'before'
glossary.ይጸንዕ: ጸንዐ — he is strong (3ms imperfect, ṣ-n-ʿ)
glossary.ዮሐዳ: ዮሐዳ (?) — Yohada (proper name, a woman's name) (?)
glossary.ዮርብዓም: ኢዮርብዓም — Jeroboam (proper name; spelled without the initial ኢ) · also Solomon's son (the Rehoboam of 1 Kings 12) as well as the Ephraimite
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ደክሙ: ደከመ — they were weary, weakened (3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ገቢረ: ገብረ — to do, doing (infinitive/verbal noun of ገብረ, accusative)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ገብሩ: ገብር — servant of (noun, construct form, followed by genitive ለ-) · his servant (ገብር + -ሁ '3ms his', ለዳዊት ገብሩ 'to David his servant')
glossary.ጸራቤ: ጸራቢ — carpenter (noun; ጸራቤ written for ጸራቢ)
glossary.ጸንዐት: ጸንዐ — it was strong (3fs perfect, G 'be strong, firm')
glossary.ፄዋወለክሙኒ: ፄዋ — slaves; and as for you (one word: ፄዋ 'captive, slave' + ወ- 'and' + ለክሙ 'to you' + -ኒ)
glossary.ፈጸሙ: ፈጸመ — they finished, completed (3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ፍጡነ: ፍጡን — quick, quickly (adjective, accusative as adverb)
glossary.፪: ፪ — 2, spoken ክልኤቱ (kəlʾetu) 'two'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'two' (ዘእንበለ ፪ በትር 'except two rods')
glossary.፵ወ፩: ፵ወ፩ — forty-one (numeral); spoken አርብዓ ወአሐዱ (arbəʿa wä-ʾähadu) 'forty and one'
